ORDER BY "dr"."rosen_id" ASC, "dr"."service_start_date" DESC LIMIT #{displayNum} OFFSET #{startRowNum}

SELECT "dr"."daiya_revision_id" AS "daiyaRevisionId" , "dr"."rosen_id" AS "rosenId" , "dr"."service_start_date" AS "serviceStartDate" , "dr"."service_end_date" AS "serviceEndDate" , "dr"."daiya_revision_name" AS "daiyaRevisionName" , "l"."rosen_name" AS "rosenName" , "l"."business_corp_id" AS "businessCorpId" FROM "daiya_revisions" AS "dr" INNER JOIN "lines" AS "l" ON "l"."del_flag" = 0 AND "l"."available_flag" = 1 AND "l"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId} AND "l"."rosen_id" = "dr"."rosen_id" INNER JOIN "agencies" AS "ag" ON "ag"."del_flag" = 0 AND "ag"."available_flag" = 1 AND "ag"."business_corp_id" = "l"."business_corp_id" WHERE "dr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "dr"."daiya_revision_id" = #{daiyaRevisionId} AND "l"."rosen_id" = #{rosenId} ORDER BY "dr"."service_start_date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "dr"."daiya_revision_id" AS "daiyaRevisionId" , to_char("dr"."service_start_date", 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS "serviceStartDate" , to_char("dr"."service_end_date", 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS "serviceEndDate" , "dr"."daiya_revision_name" FROM "daiya_revisions" AS "dr" INNER JOIN "lines" AS "l" ON "l"."del_flag" = 0 AND "l"."available_flag" = 1 AND "l"."rosen_id" = "dr"."rosen_id" INNER JOIN "agencies" AS "ag" ON "ag"."del_flag" = 0 AND "ag"."available_flag" = 1 AND "ag"."business_corp_id" = "l"."business_corp_id" WHERE "dr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "dr"."service_start_date" <= TO_DATE(#{serviceStartDate}, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND "l"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId} AND "l"."rosen_id" = #{rosenId} ORDER BY "dr"."service_start_date" DESC

SELECT "v"."vehicle_id" AS "vehicleId" , "v"."vehicle_name" AS "vehicleName" FROM "vehicles" AS "v" INNER JOIN "operating_companies" "oc" ON "oc"."operating_company_id" = "v"."operating_company_id" AND "oc"."del_flag" = 0 AND "oc"."available_flag" = 1 AND "oc"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId} WHERE "v"."del_flag" = 0 AND "v"."available_flag" = 1 ORDER BY "v"."vehicle_id" ASC

SELECT "lr"."line_route_name" AS "lineRouteName" , "lr"."line_route_id" AS "lineRouteId" , "c"."calendar_type" AS "calendarName" , "c"."calendar_id" AS "calendarId" , "bs"."block_id" AS "blockId" , "bs"."work_number" AS "workNumber" , "bs"."vehicle_id" AS "vehicleId" , "bs"."bus_service_trip_id" AS "busServiceTripId" , "bs"."bus_service_trip_desc" AS "busServiceTripDesc" , "bs"."bus_service_trip_headsign" AS "busServiceTripHeadsign" , "bs"."bus_service_trip_desc_symbol" AS "busServiceTripDescSymbol" , "bs"."bus_service_id" AS "busServiceId" , "bs"."bus_service_name" AS "busServiceName" , "bs"."office_id" AS "officeId" , "bs"."wheelchair_accessible_type" AS "wheelchairAccessibleType" , "bs"."bikes_allowed_type" AS "bikesAllowedType" , "bd"."bus_daiya_id" AS "busDaiyaDetailId" , "bd"."line_route_bus_stop_id" AS "lineRouteBusStopId" , "bd"."bus_stop_arrival_time" AS "busStopArrivalTime" , "bd"."bus_stop_departure_time" AS "busStopDepartureTime" , "lrbs"."rosen_bus_stop_id" AS "rosenBusStopId" FROM "lines" AS "l" INNER JOIN "line_routes" AS "lr" ON "lr"."rosen_id" = "l"."rosen_id" AND "lr"."available_flag" = 1 AND "lr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lr"."line_detail_service_division" = #{lineDetailServiceDivision} INNER JOIN "daiya_revisions" AS "drh" ON "drh"."rosen_id" = "l"."rosen_id" AND "drh"."daiya_revision_id" = #{daiyaRevisionId} AND "drh"."del_flag" = 0 INNER JOIN "daiya_revisions" AS "drd" ON "drd"."rosen_id" = "l"."rosen_id" AND "drd"."daiya_revision_id" = #{revisionSelect} AND "drd"."del_flag" = 0 INNER JOIN "agencies" AS "a" ON "a"."business_corp_id" = "l"."business_corp_id" AND "a"."del_flag" = 0 AND "a"."available_flag" = 1 INNER JOIN "line_route_bus_stops" AS "lrbs" ON "lrbs"."line_route_id" = "lr"."line_route_id" AND "lrbs"."del_flag" = 0 INNER JOIN "signposts" AS "s" ON "s"."signpost_id" = "lrbs"."signpost_id" AND "s"."del_flag" = 0 AND "s"."available_flag" = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN "bus_services" AS "bs" ON "bs"."line_route_id" = "lr"."line_route_id" AND "bs"."daiya_revision_id" = "drd"."daiya_revision_id" AND "bs"."del_flag" = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN "bus_daiyas" AS "bd" ON "bd"."bus_service_id" = "bs"."bus_service_id" AND "bd"."line_route_bus_stop_id" = "lrbs"."line_route_bus_stop_id" AND "bd"."del_flag" = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN "calendars" AS "c" ON "c"."calendar_id" = "bs"."calendar_id" AND "c"."available_flag" = 1 AND "c"."del_flag" = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN "vehicles" AS "v" ON "v"."vehicle_id" = "bs"."vehicle_id" AND "v"."del_flag" = 0 WHERE "l"."del_flag" = 0 AND "l"."available_flag" = 1 AND "l"."rosen_id" = #{rosenId} AND "l"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId} ORDER BY "lr"."line_route_id" ASC , "bs"."calendar_id" ASC , "bs"."bus_service_id" ASC , "lrbs"."stop_sequence" ASC

SELECT "lr"."line_route_id" AS "lineRouteId" , "lrbs"."rosen_bus_stop_id" AS "rosenBusStopId" , "lrbs"."line_route_bus_stop_id" AS "lineRouteBusStopId" FROM "line_routes" "lr" INNER JOIN "line_route_bus_stops" "lrbs" ON "lrbs"."line_route_id" = "lr"."line_route_id" AND "lrbs"."del_flag" = 0 INNER JOIN "signposts" "s" ON "lrbs"."signpost_id" = "s"."signpost_id" AND "s"."del_flag" = 0 AND "s"."available_flag" = 1 WHERE "lr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lr"."rosen_id" = #{rosenId} AND "lr"."line_detail_service_division" = #{lineDetailServiceDivision} ORDER BY "lr"."line_route_id" ASC
